known_limits: A host whose first probe fails at the transport layer gets one immediate retry, because a failed fetch can only bias toward UNREACHABLE, never toward OK. A host down for both attempts still reads UNREACHABLE, and UNREACHABLE is recorded and never treated as a state change. Retried rows say so on the row.
Verdicts are point-in-time. Comparing two dates measures the pair of observations, not an operator's intent.
The target list is itself a snapshot of a live registry and shifts between runs.

manifest.signed_manifests is a SECOND sweep over a SMALLER, separately pinned population (manifest_hosts.json), not over the target list above. Read its counts against its own population field and never against hosts_observed. Its status field says whether that day's run is quotable at all.
manifest.method: preflight.classify_both(url) — one unauthenticated request per host, GET with a POST fallback, plus one immediate retry when the only thing the first attempt observed was a transport failure. Nothing signed, nothing paid. A verdict describes what the endpoint served at that moment and nothing about the operator.
manifest.retry_rule: one immediate retry, UNREACHABLE first attempts only, never policy refusals, never answers; retried rows carry retried=true

signed_manifests.denominator_note: Counted against manifest_hosts.json, NOT against the 1,521-host target list and NOT against the whole network. Reference hosts outside the pinned target list are not in this population.
signed_manifests.method: signed_manifest.check(host) — GET /.well-known/x402 and /.well-known/x402.sig, then a DNS TXT lookup ONLY when a real signature document is present. Nothing signed, nothing paid. A 200 at the .sig path is not counted as a signature unless the body carries both a signature and a key id.

manifest.target_list_caveat: Offset pagination over a live registry is a snapshot, not an enumeration. Rows shift between requests; hosts present in one run can be absent from the next. Quote this timestamp alongside any figure derived from this run.
manifest.target_list_source: CDP Bazaar discovery listings, deduplicated to one probe URL per host
